title: Generate a full LAPS report
description: Generate a CSV report of every LAPS computer with its password and expiration date.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-ADComputer
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $report = @(); Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties ms-Mcs-AdmPwd,ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime | Where-Object {$_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd' -ne $null} | ForEach-Object { $report += [PSCustomObject]@{ Computer=$_.Name; Password=$_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd'; Expiration=[DateTime]::FromFileTime($_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime') } }; $report | Export-Csv C:\LAPS-Report-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd').csv -NoTypeInformation; Write-Host "Report generated: C:\LAPS-Report-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd').csv" -ForegroundColor Green

examples.command: $report = Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties ms-Mcs-AdmPwd,ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime | Where-Object {$_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd' -ne $null} | Select-Object Name,@{N='Password';E={$_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd'}},@{N='Expiration';E={[DateTime]::FromFileTime($_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime')}}; $report | Export-Csv C:\LAPS-Full-Report.csv -NoTypeInformation
examples.description: Generate a full CSV report with every LAPS password

examples.command: Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties ms-Mcs-AdmPwd,ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime | Where-Object {$_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd' -ne $null -and [DateTime]::FromFileTime($_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime') -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(7)} | Select-Object Name,@{N='ExpiresIn';E={([DateTime]::FromFileTime($_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime') - (Get-Date)).Days}} | Export-Csv C:\LAPS-Expiring-Soon.csv -NoTypeInformation
examples.description: Report of the computers whose LAPS password expires within 7 days

examples.command: $stats = Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties ms-Mcs-AdmPwd | Group-Object -Property {if($_.'ms-Mcs-AdmPwd'){'LAPS OK'}else{'NO LAPS'}} | Select-Object Name,Count; $stats
examples.description: LAPS coverage statistics (how many with and without LAPS)
Show the results in a table suited to the console. Format-Table -AutoSize fits the column widths for readable output. Ideal to scan structured data quickly.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: ⚠️ MAXIMUM SECURITY: this report holds ALL the local admin passwords! Store it in an encrypted vault (password manager, Azure Key Vault, physical safe). NEVER send it by unencrypted email. Delete it after use. Audit who generates these reports.
